speaker: Unknown
en: Well, thank you, everyone, for joining.
zh: 好的，感谢大家的参与。

speaker: Unknown
en: I'm hoping that you guys had a great time so far at this conference, and you guys have a lot of takeaways back to your company.
zh: 我希望你们到目前为止在这次大会上度过了一段美好的时光，并且带回了很多收获到你们公司。

speaker: Unknown
en: I don't know if any of you guys saw the AGI pills downstairs?
zh: 我不知道你们有没有人看到楼下的 AGI 药丸？

speaker: Unknown
en: Well, I just took some.
zh: 嗯，我刚吃了一些。

speaker: Unknown
en: So, if I say any phrases about that's the gun, what's that phrase?
zh: 所以，如果我说了什么关于那把枪的话，那是什么说法来着？

speaker: Unknown
en: That's the burning gun, or the smoking gun, or I start hallucinating in general, well, please snap me back.
zh: 那是烧红的枪，还是冒烟的枪，或者我开始产生幻觉了，那请把我拍醒。

speaker: Unknown
en: That's probably just the AGI pills.
zh: 那可能只是 AGI 药丸的作用。

speaker: Unknown
en: All right.
zh: 好的。

speaker: Unknown
en: So without further ado, let's get started.
zh: 那么废话不多说，我们开始吧。

speaker: Unknown
en: My name is Justin Joyce.
zh: 我叫 Justin Joyce。

speaker: Unknown
en: I'm a principal sales operations and strategy manager at Cloudflare.
zh: 我是 Cloudflare 的首席销售运营与策略经理。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I work with the go-to-market team as part of the revenue operations organization, specifically on the teams that produce leads for the sales teams, as well as the customer experience team, which works on the customer experience after the sales has been done.
zh: 我在收入运营组织中与市场进入团队合作，具体负责为销售团队产生线索的团队，以及客户体验团队，后者负责销售完成之后的客户体验。

speaker: Unknown
en: Just a little background about me.
zh: 简单介绍一下我的背景。

speaker: Unknown
en: As Mata said, I started in sales operations and sales, and then I moved to the machine learning side about the last seven years at Grainger.
zh: 正如 Mata 所说，我从销售运营和销售起步，然后在 Grainger 的最后大约七年里转向了机器学习方向。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I really wanted to do that to be able to learn how to have prescriptive analysis and prescriptive predictions so I could help the business better to make decisions and to understand what's the next best step.
zh: 我之所以想这么做，是想学会如何做规范性分析和规范性预测，这样我能更好地帮助企业做决策，理解下一步最佳行动是什么。

speaker: Unknown
en: Six months ago, I had an opportunity to move back into sales operations because I really wanted to use all the skills that I had been learning from machine learning as well as from sales operations in general.
zh: 六个月前，我有机会回到销售运营，因为我真的想把我从机器学习以及销售运营中学到的所有技能都用起来。

speaker: Unknown
en: So what's the general problem?
zh: 那么总体问题是什么？

speaker: Unknown
en: The general problem is that traditional go-to-market does not scale.
zh: 总体问题就是传统的市场进入方式无法规模化。

speaker: Unknown
en: There's a few facets to this.
zh: 这有几个方面。

speaker: Unknown
en: The first facet is that usually
zh: 第一个方面是，通常

speaker: Unknown
en: Teams on the back office side, they're either doing work in Excel or Sheets at worst, building analysis each week, multiple hours a week, and as they take on multiple projects, it gets exponentially long with how many of those analysis that they're doing.
zh: 后台职能的团队，最差的情况下要么在用 Excel 或 Sheets 做工作，每周构建分析，每周花费好几个小时，随着他们承接多个项目，这些分析的工作量会随数量呈指数级增长。

speaker: Unknown
en: At best, they are producing dashboards, providing information to the leadership and executive team, which meets the needs of most teams, but not all of them.
zh: 最好的情况下，他们制作仪表板，为领导层和高管团队提供信息，这满足了大多数团队的需求，但不是所有团队。

speaker: Unknown
en: And that means that, in general, not all the requirements of the go-to-market teams are met.
zh: 这意味着，总体来说，市场进入团队的需求并没有全部被满足。

speaker: Unknown
en: They're not able to really provide all the information that the teams need when they need it.
zh: 他们无法真正在团队需要的时候提供所有需要的信息。

speaker: Unknown
en: The second problem, which is more on the go-to-market side with the sales teams and the other teams that I mentioned that I support, is they have two gaps.
zh: 第二个问题更多是在市场进入这一侧，涉及销售团队和我提到过我支持的其他团队，就是他们有两个差距。

speaker: Unknown
en: Essentially, the first gap is the context gap, meaning when a salesperson is talking to a prospect,
zh: 本质上，第一个差距是上下文差距，意思是当一个销售人员在和一个潜在客户通话时，

speaker: Unknown
en: One call and talking to a current customer in the next call or talking an adoption conversation, the call after that, they have to constantly switch contexts and they have to gather information for those specific calls, which is good.
zh: 这一通电话，下一通电话又在和一个现有客户谈，或者再下一通是谈采用（adoption）的对话，他们必须不断切换上下文，而且他们必须为这些特定的通话收集信息，这本身是好的。

speaker: Unknown
en: They really need to get that information to have those calls and understand how to approach the situation, but they have to do all that work in between.
zh: 他们确实需要获取那些信息来进行通话并理解如何处理情况，但他们必须在通话之间完成所有这些工作。

speaker: Unknown
en: The second one was what I like to call
zh: 第二个是我想称之为

speaker: Unknown
en: is the expert gap, which is the gap between how your expert salesperson or expert go-to-market sales individual, how he would approach a situation, how he would talk to a prospect, how he would work on an adoption call, how he would handle a customer satisfaction issue, and between also a new salesperson or someone that's just ramping up.
zh: 专家差距的，即你的专家级销售人员或专家级市场进入销售个人处理一个情况的方式、他和潜在客户谈话的方式、他处理采用通话的方式、他处理客户满意度问题的方式，与一个新销售人员或一个刚上手的人之间的差距。

speaker: Unknown
en: So ideally, like everyone working at the same operational level, so you have consistency
zh: 理想情况下，就像所有人都在同一个运营水平上工作，这样你就有了一致性

speaker: Unknown
en: And execution, consistency, and messaging of how to assess a customer's problems and how your product can help fit that portfolio.
zh: 以及执行、表达的一致性，包括如何评估客户的问题，以及你的产品如何能契合那个组合。

speaker: Unknown
en: So with these two problems with manual work as well as salespeople not having enough information and having the gap of having to get all the information they need and gather that as well as not being able to execute the same level, it really creates an inefficiency in the go-to-market organization.
zh: 所以，有了这两个问题——手工工作，以及销售人员信息不足、存在必须自己获取和收集所有所需信息的差距，还有无法在同等水平上执行——这真的在市场进入组织中造成了一种低效率。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so for the last six months or so since I've joined Cloudflare, I've been really focusing on how can I make this operation efficient from back to front.
zh: 所以在我加入 Cloudflare 之后的过去六个月左右，我一直在专注于如何让这个运营从后到前都变得高效。

speaker: Unknown
en: And there's a lot of great things that we've been doing at our company in general that's helped me enable that.
zh: 我们公司在总体上做了很多很棒的事情，帮助我实现了这一点。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I really want to share some of those findings with you.
zh: 我真的很想和你们分享其中一些发现。

speaker: Unknown
en: So the framework that I'm proposing here, which I think is going to really be effective as we flesh this out in the future, is a three-pillar approach.
zh: 所以我在这里提出的框架——我认为随着我们未来把它充实起来，它会非常有效——是一个三支柱方法。

speaker: Unknown
en: The first pillar approach is how can we scale analysis and the ability of operations team to meet the data needs of executives, leadership, as well as to be able to build applications using business context.
zh: 第一个支柱是，我们如何规模化分析以及运营团队满足高管和领导层数据需求的能力，并且能够利用业务上下文构建应用。

speaker: Unknown
en: How can they take things that would take two hours to do down to five minutes?
zh: 他们如何能把原本要花两个小时的事情缩短到五分钟？

speaker: Unknown
en: Back in January of this year, after I joined the company, I had built these skills, and I started asking questions of the data directly, and I was able to get answers immediately while doing other things.
zh: 今年一月份，在我加入公司之后，我已经建立了这些技能，我开始直接向数据提问，我能够立即得到答案，同时还在做其他事情。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I saw the huge power of how, if we can scale the analysis and the operations of the teams, we can actually focus on the second part of my job, which is strategy.
zh: 我看到了巨大的力量：如果我们能规模化分析和团队的运营，我们实际上就可以专注于我工作的第二部分，也就是策略。

speaker: Unknown
en: The second pillar is to scale insight.
zh: 第二个支柱是规模化洞察。

speaker: Unknown
en: There's a story in the data, and how can we provide that to the team?
zh: 数据里有一个故事，我们如何把它提供给团队？

speaker: Unknown
en: How can we provide that team at the weekly level, at the different levels of management?
zh: 我们如何以周为单位、在不同的管理层级上把这个故事提供给团队？

speaker: Unknown
en: How can we provide that information, that insight, that story to every customer that these sales teams are talking to?
zh: 我们如何把这些信息、这些洞察、这个故事提供给这些销售团队正在接触的每一个客户？

speaker: Unknown
en: And the third one, which is arguably the biggest one, is to provide self-service capabilities to the go-to-market team.
zh: 第三个，可以说最大的一个，是为市场进入团队提供自助服务能力。

speaker: Unknown
en: When these sales individuals, when they're talking to a customer, how can they get the expert-level information that they need to interact with that customer and to best assess how they should approach the situation, how to handle rejections, how to upsell them, and how to handle customer satisfaction issues?
zh: 当这些销售人员在与客户交谈时，他们如何获得所需专家级的信息来与那个客户互动，并最好地评估他们应该如何处理情况、如何应对拒绝、如何向上销售，以及如何处理客户满意度问题？

speaker: Unknown
en: This is a huge part of what I've seen we've done at Cloudflare, and I'll share in a little bit what that looks like.
zh: 这是我在 Cloudflare 看到我们所做工作的很大一部分，稍后我会分享那是什么样子。

speaker: Unknown
en: So as it relates to scaling the analytical capability, the back office operations, what we have done is we've built role-specific skill files which have the context of this business information tying it to the data.
zh: 所以，关于规模化分析能力、后台运营这块，我们所做的是构建了特定角色的技能文件，其中包含把这些业务信息的上下文与数据关联起来的内容。

speaker: Unknown
en: This is for both technical and non-technical users.
zh: 这既面向技术用户，也面向非技术用户。

speaker: Unknown
en: Technical users, you could say the ones who are building SQL and being able to data engineer a lot of solutions.
zh: 技术型用户，可以说就是那些构建 SQL、能够对大量解决方案做数据工程的人。

speaker: Unknown
en: And then the non-technical people will be more individuals who are closer to the business with the salespeople who may not know how to write SQL.
zh: 然后非技术型用户则更多是更贴近业务的个人，比如那些可能不会写 SQL 的销售人员。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so we have skill files that they're able to use to ask questions of the data to get answers fairly quickly while doing other tasks.
zh: 所以我们提供了技能文件，他们可以用它来向数据提问，在处理其他任务的同时相当快速地获得答案。

speaker: Unknown
en: And an example here is in those skill files, we also, through testing, we've included the types of questions that the business would ask of the data.
zh: 这里的一个例子是，在这些技能文件中，我们还通过测试纳入了业务会向数据提出的各类问题。

speaker: Unknown
en: In this case, looking at close date changes in opportunities, as well as changes in the amount of the opportunities, so that we can answer essentially 80% or more of the questions, where the other 20% might be more complex strategic questions.
zh: 在这个案例中，是查看商机(close date)的变化以及商机金额的变化，这样我们基本上能回答 80% 或更多的问题，而另外 20% 可能是更复杂的战略性问题。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so overall, this allows the teams to be able to embed all of the logic into these skill files and get answers fairly quickly.
zh: 所以总体而言，这使得团队能够把所有逻辑都嵌入到这些技能文件中，并相当快速地获得答案。

speaker: Unknown
en: So I've seen users who do not know any SQL, and essentially their requests in the past, we bottleneck to someone who knows data and can write SQL for complex queries, be able to just ask questions of the data and get answers.
zh: 我见过完全不懂 SQL 的用户，过去他们的请求会成为瓶颈，要交给懂数据、能为复杂查询编写 SQL 的人，而现在他们能够直接向数据提问并获得答案。

speaker: Unknown
en: And this is very useful also for what I show later on the third pillar is for building skills for these go-to-market teams so that they can ask questions of their data and get answers.
zh: 这对于我稍后在第三支柱中展示的内容也非常有用，即为这些市场进入(go-to-market)团队构建技能，让他们能够向自己的数据提问并获得答案。

speaker: Unknown
en: Also, in our team, we've used these same skill files to build multiple applications.
zh: 另外，在我们的团队中，我们也用这些相同的技能文件构建了多个应用程序。

speaker: Unknown
en: When usually that is done in IT and bottlenecked in those areas, we're able to use the semantic information about the business knowledge as well as the columns to be able to build these applications rather quickly.
zh: 通常这类工作是由 IT 完成并在那些环节形成瓶颈的，而我们能够利用关于业务知识的语义信息以及列信息，相当快速地构建这些应用程序。

speaker: Unknown
en: So this allows us to free up our time so that we can focus on strategy and enablement.
zh: 这让我们得以腾出时间，专注于战略和赋能(enablement)。

speaker: Unknown
en: For the second pillar, what I mentioned earlier, there's a story in the data, and they really shouldn't have to search for it.
zh: 对于第二支柱，也就是我之前提到的，数据中有一个故事，而人们其实不应该非得自己去搜索它。

speaker: Unknown
en: What I'm showing you here is synthetic data on the right.
zh: 我在这里展示的是右侧的合成数据。

speaker: Unknown
en: We have a weekly summary that goes out, which highlights how the business is doing, how they're pacing to their goals, and then highlighting trends, standouts, as well as watches.
zh: 我们有一份每周发出的摘要，突出展示业务的进展情况、他们相对于目标的进度节奏，然后突出趋势、亮点以及需要关注的事项。

speaker: Unknown
en: This we provide this information to the business so they can as you just like you can open your phone now on Gemini if you have it and you can see your notes for the day or the things that you need to do giving that same level of information to the go to market team so they can just go along their day and if they do need to look at some of the reports or dashboards they can to drill in but we bring the story to them.
zh: 我们向业务提供这些信息，让他们可以——就像你现在可以打开手机上的 Gemini,查看你当天的备忘或需要做的事情一样——向市场进入团队提供同样级别的信息，让他们可以就这样过好自己的一天，如果他们确实需要查看某些报告或仪表板，他们可以深入查看，但我们把故事带给他们。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I'll pull this together why I think this is really important.
zh: 我来把这些汇总起来，说明为什么我认为这非常重要。

speaker: Unknown
en: Of course, there's a place for dashboards in standardized information, but there's a different level of adoption of the KPI metrics at any given company.
zh: 当然，仪表板和标准化信息有其用武之地，但在任何一家公司，KPI 指标的采纳程度是分层次的。

speaker: Unknown
en: You're going to have people who love dashboards.
zh: 你会遇到热爱仪表板的人。

speaker: Unknown
en: People are never going to look at them.
zh: 也会有永远不去看仪表板的人。

speaker: Unknown
en: So I think you really need to have a way to scaffold that across
zh: 所以我认为你真的需要有一种方式来搭建跨越的脚手架，

speaker: Unknown
en: The business.
zh: 覆盖整个业务。

speaker: Unknown
en: So how do we do this automated analysis?
zh: 那么我们是如何做这种自动化分析的呢？

speaker: Unknown
en: So a big part of this is simplifying the data so that the AI agents can actually analyze the data in a very consistent and clean way.
zh: 其中很大一部分是简化数据，使 AI 智能体能够以一种非常一致、干净的方式实际分析数据。

speaker: Unknown
en: Here what we do is we transform the data by the dimension of time, also slice of the logical part of the business, which is manager, theater, and finally the metric.
zh: 这里我们所做的是按时间维度对数据进行转换，也按业务逻辑部分进行切分，也就是管理者(manager)、区域(theater),最后是指标。

speaker: Unknown
en: Here we have data that is wide.
zh: 这里我们有宽格式的数据。

speaker: Unknown
en: You could also go from wide to long.
zh: 你也可以从宽格式转为长格式。

speaker: Unknown
en: Our trend information that I showed you,
zh: 我给你们展示的趋势信息，

speaker: Unknown
en: That data is long, and then we do some pre-processing on that data to then highlight trends.
zh: 那些数据是长格式的，然后我们对这些数据做一些预处理，以突出趋势。

speaker: Unknown
en: So the embedding of the logic of how you would filter this data to even analyze it, as well as the logical aggregations the business would want to see, is all engineered up front.
zh: 所以，如何筛选这些数据以进行分析的逻辑的嵌入，以及业务希望看到的逻辑聚合，都是在前期就工程化好的。

speaker: Unknown
en: From my experience, this handles 80-plus percent of the requests.
zh: 根据我的经验，这能处理 80% 以上的请求。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's just getting information about the performance of the teams and how they're doing.
zh: 这些请求只是想了解团队的表现以及他们做得怎么样。

speaker: Unknown
en: You can always go down to the raw data, but this last pillar, which I'll go over in a minute, allows them to do that.
zh: 你总是可以下钻到原始数据，而这最后一个支柱——我马上会讲到——允许他们做到这一点。

speaker: Unknown
en: To be able to orchestrate this effectively and be able to rely on it, we have a multi-agent workflow where we first get the data, and then we do a first-pass draft on the data, calling our MCPs.
zh: 为了能够有效地编排这一切并能够依赖它，我们有一个多智能体工作流：首先获取数据，然后对数据做初稿，调用我们的 MCP。

speaker: Unknown
en: And then we have a second reviewer agent who checks the veracity of the data.
zh: 然后我们有第二个审阅者智能体，检查数据的真实性。

speaker: Unknown
en: And then we have a third agent, which is a tone agent who, using a multi-shot prompt, is able to craft the message and highlight the risks and opportunities equally.
zh: 然后我们有第三个智能体，是一个语气智能体，它使用多示例提示词(multi-shot prompt),能够撰写消息并同等程度地突出风险与机会。

speaker: Unknown
en: And with every run, we have observability into each of the LLM calls, so we can see what is passed and what is the response that is going on there.
zh: 而且每一次运行，我们对每个 LLM 调用都有可观测性，所以我们能看到传入了什么、以及那里的响应是什么。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so this architecture we tested for about two, three months and, you know, looking at every single run to see what is going wrong.
zh: 这个架构我们测试了大约两三个月，你知道的，查看每一次运行，看看出了什么问题。

speaker: Unknown
en: And this is the model that we had set up that is really working for us.
zh: 这就是我们搭建起来的、对我们真正有效的模型。

speaker: Unknown
en: And we really hope to expand this beyond just what I've shown you for multiple teams, but also down to the customer level like I was just talking to you about.
zh: 我们真心希望能把它扩展到超越我所展示的范围，覆盖多个团队，同时下沉到客户层面，就像我刚才跟你们谈到的那样。

speaker: Unknown
en: The third part is the self-service model.
zh: 第三部分是自助服务模式。

speaker: Unknown
en: And what I'm showing you here is our internal tool called Cloudflare OS, which is an agentic workspace that is running on Cloudflare, where the go-to-market team can come in here.
zh: 我在这里展示的是我们的内部工具，叫做 Cloudflare OS,这是一个运行在 Cloudflare 上的智能体工作区，市场进入团队可以进入这里。

speaker: Unknown
en: It spins up their own compute and their own persistent environment using Cloudflare workers as well as durable objects, which is basically a storage, sort of like S3.
zh: 它使用 Cloudflare Workers 以及 Durable Objects(基本上是一种存储，有点像 S3)为他们启动自己的计算资源和自己的持久化环境。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so the salespeople can come in here and get the data that they need it when they need it.
zh: 这样销售人员就可以进来，在需要的时候获取他们需要的数据。

speaker: Unknown
en: So some use cases that these teams are using it for is doing a forecast brief, building QBR decks, building a purchase deck on what the customer that they're onboarding has purchased, doing account planning, general queries of the data, as well as renewal preparation.
zh: 这些团队使用它的一些用例包括：制作预测简报、制作 QBR 幻灯片、针对他们正在接入的客户制作关于其已购买内容的购买说明幻灯片、进行客户规划、对数据做一般性查询，以及续约准备。

speaker: Unknown
